entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-11-30
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • `JIT/opt/ObjectStackAllocation/Runtime_121736/Runtime_121736` times out under GCStress #122063
  • Sve2_ConvertToSingleOddRoundToOdd_float_double test failure #122062
    11.0.0
  • "Helix API does not contain an entry for $(helix_macos_arm64)" failures in some pipelines #122061
  • runtime-jit-experimental fails in JIT/opt/InstructionCombining/CompareZero #122060
    11.0.0
  • [RyuJIT] Bad CodeGen with Dynamic PGO + JitStressRegs=2 on .NET 8 (x64) #122057

Closed

  • Microsoft.ExtendedReflection support for CoreClr #9030
  • C# 14 extension syntax produces incorrect compiler warnings with params keyword and nullable reference types #122044
  • Request for Official FreeBSD Support in .NET 10 #122058
  • JIT: Allow containment to reorder the same single exceptions #86173
    11.0.0

PullRequests

Created

  • Mark Runtime_121736 test as GCStressIncompatible #122064
  • FormattedLogValues - Small optimization for index operator #122059
    area-Extensions-Logging, community-contribution, 11.0.0

Merged

  • Simplify Uri's CreateHelper #122002
    area-System.Net, 11.0.0
  • JIT: Improve interference checks for thrown exceptions and enable CSE/hoisting of GVM resolution helpers #122017
    area-CodeGen-coreclr

Updated

  • Fix IndexOutOfRangeException in ILVerify for invalid exception handler offsets #122056
    blocked, area-Tools-ILVerification
  • arm64: Fix Sve2 ShiftArithmeticRoundedSaturate Helper #121924
    community-contribution, needs-area-label
  • fix: CreateSubdirectory failing for root directories #121906
    area-System.IO, community-contribution
  • JIT: Devirtualize generic virtual methods #122023
    area-CodeGen-coreclr, community-contribution
  • Update Ping.Windows.cs for async task handling #122054
    NO-MERGE, area-System.Net, community-contribution
